countries_thin_or_null: Cuba, Haiti, Trinidad and Tobago, Bahamas, Barbados, OECS — additional primary CPI/NA methodology statements remain thin or already covered in batch1

proposed_reports.title: Consumer Price Index (CPI) Jamaica
proposed_reports.description: Official monthly CPI; classification uses COICOP; concepts consistent with the CPI Manual.

proposed_reports.title: Jamaican System of National Accounts
proposed_reports.description: National accounts compiled primarily under the 1993 SNA framework (process of conversion to 2008 SNA noted in public briefings).

dependencies.basis: IMF DQAF for Jamaica CPI states the classification system is COICOP Version 2.0 (the version associated with the 1999/2004 framework).
dependencies.evidence_quote: The classification system used for the CPI is the Classification of Individual Consumption according to Purpose (COICOP) Version 2.0

dependencies.basis: DQAF states CPI data are consistent with the concepts and definitions of the Consumer Price Index Manual: Theory and Practice (2004).
dependencies.evidence_quote: The CPI data that are published are consistent with the concepts and definitions of the Consumer Price Index Manual: Theory and Practice (2004)

dependencies.basis: STATIN's own national accounts concepts document and public briefings state compilation in accordance with the 1993 SNA (with conversion to 2008 SNA in process as of 2018).
dependencies.evidence_quote: The national accounts for Jamaica are compiled in accordance with the United Nations System of National Accounts 1993 (1993 SNA)
